assertions.description: The base LoAF entry type exists on the main thread (shipped Chrome 123) — the vocabulary being extended.
Inside a real dedicated worker, PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes includes long-animation-frame (the extension this feature ships).
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const src = 'postMessage(PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.includes("long-animation-frame"));'; const w = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src], { type: 'application/javascript' }))); const r = await new Promise((res, rej) => { const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('timeout')), 2000); w.onmessage = (e) => { clearTimeout(t); res(e.data); }; }); w.terminate(); return r === true; })()

assertions.description: A PerformanceObserver constructed inside a worker accepts observe({type: 'long-animation-frame'}) without throwing.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const src = 'let ok; try { new PerformanceObserver(() => {}).observe({ type: "long-animation-frame" }); ok = true; } catch (e) { ok = false; } postMessage(ok);'; const w = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src], { type: 'application/javascript' }))); const r = await new Promise((res, rej) => { const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('timeout')), 2000); w.onmessage = (e) => { clearTimeout(t); res(e.data); }; }); w.terminate(); return r === true; })()

assertions.description: A 300ms synchronous block of a worker's event loop produces a long-animation-frame entry observable inside that worker with duration covering the block.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const src = 'let armed = false; try { new PerformanceObserver((l) => { const e = l.getEntries()[0]; if (e) postMessage({ duration: e.duration }); }).observe({ type: "long-animation-frame" }); armed = true; } catch (err) { postMessage({ unsupported: true }); } onmessage = () => { const end = performance.now() + 300; while (performance.now() < end) {} };'; const w = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src], { type: 'application/javascript' }))); const result = await new Promise((res) => { const t = setTimeout(() => res({ timeout: true }), 4000); w.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data.unsupported) { clearTimeout(t); res(e.data); } else if (e.data.duration) { clearTimeout(t); res(e.data); } }; w.postMessage('block'); }); w.terminate(); return typeof result.duration === 'number' && result.duration >= 250; })()

assertions.description: The extension must not regress the main thread: a 250ms rAF-anchored block still produces a main-thread LoAF entry.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ if (!PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.includes('long-animation-frame')) return false; return await new Promise((res) => { const t = setTimeout(() => res(false), 4000); new PerformanceObserver((l) => { if (l.getEntries().some((e) => e.duration >= 200)) { clearTimeout(t); res(true); } }).observe({ type: 'long-animation-frame' }); requestAnimationFrame(() => { const end = performance.now() + 250; while (performance.now() < end) {} }); }); })()
